paper_title: Hierarchical Catalogue Generation for Literature Review A Benchmark

model_annotation: This pie chart visualizes the distribution of item numbers across three hierarchical categories. The chart is divided into a total of three slices, which are slightly separated from one another by thin white borders. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, text labels are positioned entirely outside the pie adjacent to their corresponding slices, while exact percentage values are displayed centrally inside each slice. The largest segment, located on the left side and colored medium blue, is labeled "Level2 - 12.1" and accounts for 44.32% of the whole. The second largest slice, situated in the top right and colored light blue, is labeled "Level1 - 8.2" and represents 30.04%. The smallest slice, positioned in the bottom right and shaded dark blue, is labeled "Level3 - 7.0" and makes up the remaining 25.64%. Visually, the categories are arranged in a counter-clockwise order starting from the top right based on their numerical level labels (Level1, Level2, Level3), rather than being sorted sequentially by descending or ascending proportional size.
